submit_reasoning: The price history shows a clear downtrend from ~76 to ~54 over 137 bars, with the last value at 54.26. Series stats confirm a high coefficient of variation (14.4%) and a declining trend. No seasonality was detected (strength 0.0). Anomaly detection found 18 anomalies but the rolling median residual detector is supported. All forecast runs (history-only and event-informed) selected the linear_trend model and produced identical trajectories. Context events from the article (FDA EUA submission, international approvals, analyst revenue guidance, combination vaccine results) were all rejected by the ablation gate — likely because the article's 2022 dates fall outside the data's internal date range. The forecast projects a continued gradual decline from ~50.37 to ~42.96 over 33 steps, consistent with the persistent downtrend. Support is degraded due to limited evaluation folds, but this is the best available forecast.
